name: molding
description: 封膠成型（Molding）：代表以封膠材料包覆封裝內的元件，提供保護與結構支撐的製程。模型會依目前製程的平面範圍，在目前製程表面向上新增指定材料與厚度的封膠層，並將後續製程表面移至新層頂部。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by molding. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: material
parameterDefinitions.description: Molding material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: thickness
parameterDefinitions.description: Molding thickness deposited from the current process cursor plane.

name: PnP
description: 取放與定位（Pick and Place，PnP）：將晶片或封裝元件放到主結構的指定位置，建立後續組裝的配置。模型會依每筆目標區域與元件的尺寸調整規則產生元件，再定位到主結構上；若元件底部有凸塊，會對齊並接觸主結構上可配對的凸塊，否則底部對齊目前製程表面。此步完成放置，凸塊接合需由後續 MR joint 或 TCB joint 完成。

inputPorts.name: die_geometry
inputPorts.description: Component geometry whose adaptation contract determines target-region materialization.

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Main package geometry state that receives placed component child scopes.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by adaptive placement.

parameterDefinitions.name: placements
parameterDefinitions.description: Absolute target region for every component instance; pose is fixed at zero and anchor is fixed at center.

name: ECL
description: ECL 成層：在目前製程表面新增一層指定材料，代表製程堆疊中的 ECL 材料層。模型會依目前製程的平面範圍，將邊緣向內退縮指定的保留距離（koz）後，向上建立指定厚度（thk）的材料層，並將後續製程表面移至新層頂部。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by ECL. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: material
parameterDefinitions.description: ECL material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive ECL thickness deposited from the current process cursor plane.

parameterDefinitions.name: koz
parameterDefinitions.description: Keep out zone distance applied as an inward XY inset from the process footprint.

name: DAF
description: 晶片黏著膜成層（Die Attach Film，DAF）：代表在晶片與基板或另一顆晶片之間加入黏著膜，供後續貼合與堆疊使用。模型會依目前製程的平面範圍，在整體結構最上方新增指定材料與厚度的 DAF 層，並將後續製程表面移至新層頂部。此步只建立黏著膜層，元件放置與載板貼合由各自的步驟完成。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state that receives the DAF layer. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: DAF material
parameterDefinitions.description: DAF material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: DAF thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive DAF thickness deposited on the full geometry top.

name: FOW
description: 覆線黏著膜成層（Film Over Wire，FOW）：代表堆疊晶片時，用於包覆下層焊線並黏接上層晶片的膜層。模型會依目前製程的平面範圍，在整體結構最上方新增指定材料與厚度的 FOW 層，並將後續製程表面移至新層頂部；目前以材料層表示，不模擬焊線包覆細節。後續 Debond 會保留此層。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state that receives the FOW layer. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: FOW material
parameterDefinitions.description: FOW material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: FOW thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive FOW thickness deposited on the full geometry top.

name: RDL layer
description: 重佈線層製作（Redistribution Layer，RDL）：代表以絕緣介電層、垂直導通孔與平面導線重新分配晶片的電性連接位置，供後續凸塊或其他元件連接。模型會依設定順序逐層增加堆疊厚度，在奇數層建立介電層與向下導通孔，在偶數層建立平面導線與介電層；各層的材料、厚度與導體密度由 layers 指定。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by RDL. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: layers
parameterDefinitions.description: RDL layer stack. Odd-numbered layers create downward via features after dielectric deposit; even-numbered layers create circuit features before dielectric deposit.

itemParameterDefinitions.name: Dielectric
itemParameterDefinitions.description: Dielectric material name or material entity id.

itemParameterDefinitions.name: Conductivity
itemParameterDefinitions.description: Conductivity material name or material entity id.

itemParameterDefinitions.name: thk
itemParameterDefinitions.description: Positive thickness for this dielectric layer and its conductivity feature envelope.

itemParameterDefinitions.name: density
itemParameterDefinitions.description: Conductivity feature density recorded as a 0 to 100 percentage value.

name: Grinding
description: 研磨減薄（Grinding）：代表從結構表面移除材料，以降低厚度或露出下方結構的製程。模型會從整體結構最高處向下移除指定厚度（thk），將超過研磨後高度的材料與特徵截短或移除；平面尺寸維持不變。thk 是要移除的厚度，並非研磨後的剩餘厚度。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by grinding. The operation uses the full geometry top, not cursorZ.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive grinding thickness removed downward from the highest Z in the full geometry tree.

name: saw
description: 切割分離（Saw／Dicing）：代表從晶圓、面板或較大結構中切出所需晶片或封裝單元的製程。模型會保留左下角與右上角座標所指定的 XY 矩形，裁除該範圍外的材料、特徵與子元件，並將後續製程的平面範圍更新為此矩形。此步以保留區域表示切割結果，不模擬刀具路徑或切割道寬度。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by saw. The operation keeps only geometry inside the retained XY rectangle.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: bottomLeftX
parameterDefinitions.description: Retained rectangle lower-left X coordinate.

parameterDefinitions.name: bottomLeftY
parameterDefinitions.description: Retained rectangle lower-left Y coordinate.

parameterDefinitions.name: topRightX
parameterDefinitions.description: Retained rectangle upper-right X coordinate.

parameterDefinitions.name: topRightY
parameterDefinitions.description: Retained rectangle upper-right Y coordinate.

name: Debond
description: 載板解鍵合（Debond）：代表完成暫時支撐用途後，將載板與產品結構分離的製程。模型會移除整體結構最上方唯一的載板；若其底面連接一層形狀與平面範圍相同的 DAF，也會一併移除，未連接的 DAF 與 FOW 則保留。執行前須讓目標載板位於最上方；若位置或配對不符合條件，會回報錯誤。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by debond. Exactly one carrier body in the full tree must reach the geometry top; a touching DAF is optional and must have the same primitive type and XY footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

name: Carrier Bond
description: 載板鍵合（Carrier Bond）：代表將晶圓或封裝結構貼合到暫時載板，提供後續研磨、翻面或成層時所需的支撐。模型會將輸入載板的材料層堆疊到主結構最上方，保留載板及其附帶 DAF 等材料層的身分，並將後續製程表面移至貼合後的頂部；載板輸入須包含 carrier 材料層。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Main geometry state that receives bonded carrier direct root bodies.

inputPorts.name: carrier_geometry
inputPorts.description: Carrier geometry state. Only root direct bodies are copied and their keys are preserved. At least one direct body must use key carrier; additional bodies may use other registered keys.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

name: Flip
description: 結構翻面（Flip）：代表將晶片、晶圓或封裝上下翻轉，讓另一面朝向後續加工或組裝方向；例如將晶片凸塊面朝下以供 PnP 放置。模型會反轉整個結構的上下位置及導通孔、凸塊的方向，再平移結構使最低處回到 Z=0，並重新設定後續製程表面。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by Flip. The operation mirrors the full geometry tree but derives the output cursor only from direct root bodies.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

name: Under Fill
description: 底部填膠（Underfill）：代表在晶片與主結構之間的凸塊接合區填入膠材，以支撐接點並分散應力。模型會在元件的凸塊高度範圍建立填膠材料，並填補相鄰元件之間不超過指定距離（gap）的平面間隙；元件間填膠的高度由 thk 指定。此步新增填膠結構，後續製程表面高度維持不變。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Main package geometry state containing root child die scopes to be underfilled.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: material
parameterDefinitions.description: Underfill material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive root die-to-die gap fill height deposited from cursorZ.

parameterDefinitions.name: gap
parameterDefinitions.description: Maximum die-to-die XY gap distance that underfill is allowed to fill.

name: Micro Bump
description: 微凸塊成形（Micro Bump）：代表在晶片、晶圓或封裝表面形成細間距互連凸塊，供晶片堆疊或高密度接合使用。模型會在目前製程表面上方建立指定材料、厚度與密度的凸塊特徵區域，記錄邊緣保留距離（koz），並視為已完成單側回焊成形。與另一側凸塊的接合由後續 Joint 步驟完成。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Die, wafer, or panel geometry state consumed by micro bump formation. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: material
parameterDefinitions.description: Micro bump material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive micro bump thickness. The bump bottom is aligned to cursorZ and extends upward.

parameterDefinitions.name: density
parameterDefinitions.description: Micro bump density recorded as a 0 to 100 percentage value.

parameterDefinitions.name: koz
parameterDefinitions.description: Keep out zone distance recorded on generated micro bump features for downstream keep-out handling.

name: BGA Bump
description: 球柵陣列凸塊成形（Ball Grid Array，BGA）：代表形成封裝對外連接所用的焊球陣列，供後續與基板或電路板組裝。模型會在目前製程表面上方建立指定材料、厚度與密度的 BGA 凸塊特徵區域，記錄邊緣保留距離（koz），並視為已完成單側回焊成形；此步以整體特徵區域表示焊球分布，不逐顆建立焊球。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Die, wafer, or panel geometry state consumed by BGA bump formation. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: material
parameterDefinitions.description: BGA bump material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive BGA bump thickness. The bump bottom is aligned to cursorZ and extends upward.

parameterDefinitions.name: density
parameterDefinitions.description: BGA bump density recorded as a 0 to 100 percentage value.

parameterDefinitions.name: koz
parameterDefinitions.description: Keep out zone distance recorded on generated BGA bump features for downstream keep-out handling.

name: C4 Bump
description: 覆晶凸塊成形（Controlled Collapse Chip Connection，C4）：代表在晶片或封裝表面形成覆晶接合所用的焊料凸塊，供後續連接基板或其他互連結構。模型會在目前製程表面上方建立指定材料、厚度與密度的 C4 凸塊特徵區域，記錄邊緣保留距離（koz），並視為已完成單側回焊成形。此步建立凸塊，實際組裝接合由後續 Joint 步驟表示。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Die, wafer, or panel geometry state consumed by C4 bump formation. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: material
parameterDefinitions.description: C4 bump material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive C4 bump thickness. The bump bottom is aligned to cursorZ and extends upward.

parameterDefinitions.name: density
parameterDefinitions.description: C4 bump density recorded as a 0 to 100 percentage value.

parameterDefinitions.name: koz
parameterDefinitions.description: Keep out zone distance recorded on generated C4 bump features for downstream keep-out handling.

name: tmv
description: 通模導通孔製作（Through Mold Via，TMV）：代表在封膠區形成垂直導電通道，供封裝上下層或堆疊封裝之間互連。模型會依目前製程的平面範圍，在目前製程表面上方建立指定材料、厚度與密度的向上導通孔特徵區域；此步以導通孔特徵表示結果，不模擬鑽孔或鍍填流程，後續製程表面高度維持不變。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Geometry state consumed by TMV formation. The state must already carry a process footprint.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

parameterDefinitions.name: thk
parameterDefinitions.description: Positive TMV thickness. The via bottom is aligned to cursorZ and extends upward without advancing the cursor.

parameterDefinitions.name: material
parameterDefinitions.description: TMV material name or material entity id.

parameterDefinitions.name: density
parameterDefinitions.description: TMV density recorded as a 0 to 100 percentage value.

name: Frame Mount
description: 框架上片（Frame Mount）：代表將晶圓或封裝結構固定到框架膠帶等支撐材料上，供後續搬運或切割使用。模型會將輸入的單一 frame 材料層貼到主結構最上方，並將後續製程表面移至該層頂部；實際支撐形狀由 frame_geometry 決定，例如目前 fixture 使用框架膠帶。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state that receives the mounted frame body at its full geometry top.

inputPorts.name: frame_geometry
inputPorts.description: Frame geometry containing exactly one root-direct body keyed frame and no other geometry.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

name: Frame Demount
description: 框架卸片（Frame Demount）：代表支撐用途完成後，將產品與框架膠帶等支撐材料分離的製程。模型會移除整體結構最上方唯一的 frame 材料層，並將後續製程表面更新到剩餘結構的頂部。執行前須讓目標 frame 層位於最上方；若沒有符合條件的層或同時有多個候選層，會回報錯誤。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Complete geometry state consumed by frame demount. Exactly one frame body in the full tree must reach the geometry top.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Geometry state produced by this process step.

name: MR joint
description: 整體回焊接合（Mass Reflow，MR）：代表 PnP 放置後，透過回焊讓元件與主結構兩側的凸塊形成接點。模型會接合已配對且接觸的回焊凸塊，將元件側凸塊標記為已接合，並調整元件高度，使主結構接合表面到元件本體底面的總間距等於 bump_joined_height。目前 MR 與 TCB 使用相同的幾何接合模型，不模擬溫度歷程。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Assembly after PnP, with contacting reflowed bumps on both sides.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Assembly with joined child bumps and adjusted child heights.

parameterDefinitions.name: Bump joined height
parameterDefinitions.description: Total main-surface-to-die-body gap after joint, not an added upper-bump thickness.

name: TCB joint
description: 熱壓接合（Thermocompression Bonding，TCB）：代表 PnP 放置後，透過加熱與施壓讓元件與主結構兩側的凸塊形成接點。模型會接合已配對且接觸的回焊凸塊，將元件側凸塊標記為已接合，並調整元件高度，使主結構接合表面到元件本體底面的總間距等於 bump_joined_height。目前 TCB 與 MR 使用相同的幾何接合模型，不模擬溫度或壓力歷程。

inputPorts.name: main_geometry
inputPorts.description: Assembly after PnP, with contacting reflowed bumps on both sides.

outputPorts.name: Result geometry
outputPorts.description: Assembly with joined child bumps and adjusted child heights.

parameterDefinitions.name: Bump joined height
parameterDefinitions.description: Total main-surface-to-die-body gap after joint, not an added upper-bump thickness.
